handback.title: Delete the planner's old post and reject steps
handback.summary: Deletes the planner's unused post and reject steps and its old plan writer, with their tests.
handback.user_story: The planner keeps only its check, so no unused code can post plans or rejections on issues.

acceptance_criteria.text: Asking the planner to post a plan no longer posts anything on the issue.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A deleted step takes no input left to vary.

acceptance_criteria.text: Asking the planner to report a rejected plan no longer posts anything on the issue.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: A deleted step takes no input left to vary.

acceptance_criteria.text: The old writer of a plan into the issue's text is deleted from the planner.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Deleted code takes no input left to vary.

acceptance_criteria.text: The old plan text builder is deleted from the planner.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Deleted code takes no input left to vary.
